title: Meet Our Team - Hawai'i Wildfires Recovery Mission
description: Christina Etzrodt, a geographer from the Omaha District, shares a few thoughts on her recent deployment to Maui in support of the 2023 Hawai'i Wildfires Recovery mission. This is Christina's tenth emergency operations deployment.
keywords: wildfires, Emergency Operations, Maui Wildfires, Hawaii wildfires recovery mission
unit_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Northwestern Division

transcript.text: Hi, I'm Christina Etzroad. I'm with Army Corps of Engineers Omaha District. I'm a
geographer back home, but here in Lahaina I'm working as an environmental engineer
monitoring the contractor's soil samplers and I will shadow them and go from
parcel to parcel monitoring their activities. I'm grateful that I feel I
have a skill set to be able to contribute to the recovery efforts. It always feels
good to be able to give back. I've seen this kind of devastation in other
deployments and it's always incredibly heartbreaking and I am fortunate that I
am able to help bear that burden a little bit and help with recovery.
